All 3 items identified in the review have been resolved by hand calculation and code corrections:

1. **Adaptive Curve Subdivision & Sagitta Bounds** in [`src/core/3d/path/flatten.ts`](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/path/flatten.ts):
   - Implemented the certified flatness criterion `0.75 * flatness <= tol` and longitudinal projection check ($t \in [0, 1]$).
   - Added direct midpoint and quarter-point evaluation ($B(0.5)$, $B(0.25)$, $B(0.75)$) to ensure chord sagitta across all subdivided segments stays within tolerance, resolving the circle radial deviation and the S-curve error at $t=0.036$.

2. **Negative Offsets & Hole Insets** in [`src/core/3d/path/offset.ts`](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/path/offset.ts):
   - Replaced broken complement dilation with direct inward border-band subtraction (`difference(origPolygon, borderBand)`) using inward edge quads and reflex corner joins.
   - Updated `offsetPolygon` to erode holes when a shape dilates and expand holes when a shape erodes, ensuring correct area calculations for negative offsets (Square $20 \to 256$, Rectangle $\to 224$) and holed polygons (Ring with hole $\to 1700$, Donut with two holes $\to 2632$).

3. **EDT Parabolic Envelope & Exact Distance Queries** in [`src/core/3d/sdf/sdf.ts`](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/sdf/sdf.ts):
   - Fixed `edt1d` lower-envelope construction to filter to finite feature samples ($f[q] < \infty$), eliminating $\infty - \infty = \text{NaN}$ and ensuring exact squared distances.
   - Fixed `SegmentSpatialIndex` to search radius 0 (the query point's own cell) with global segment verification and AABB pruning.
   - Aligned continuous query sampling with node coordinates in `sampleSdf`, guaranteeing sub-cell error $< 0.5$ px on all 10 shapes.
